findings.title: Exact ESPAI v1 and v3 rights and links
findings.finding: Both exact-version pages link CC BY 4.0, their matching vN PDF and matching vN source. Submission times are 2024-01-05T14:53:09Z and 2025-10-08T18:38:53Z. No manuscript or source package was requested.
findings.integration_action: Retain exact edition identifiers and rights evidence. Keep source-package transport and member-level exceptions unresolved; do not extend paper rights to separately linked assets.

findings.title: Generic citation metadata loses exact version
findings.finding: All three checked version pages expose an unversioned citation_pdf_url, while visible PDF and source hrefs retain the requested vN.
findings.integration_action: Use the exact-version href. Add a rejection test for silent latest-version substitution; a versioned landing URL alone does not pin the generic metadata URL.

findings.title: CN017 v1 has a different rights basis
findings.finding: 2310.19852v1 links arXiv nonexclusive-distribution 1.0, not CC BY. Its later v2-v6 history does not establish those versions’ rights.
findings.integration_action: Preserve the exact v1 rights classification. Research-private storage relies separately on the parent-verified arXiv terms; public serving remains uncleared.

findings.title: Uploaded OpenAlex response independently reproduced
findings.finding: The preprint-DOI GET returned W4414876758 with canonical JAIR DOI 10.1613/jair.1.19087. The new 18,977-byte response matches the uploaded SHA-256 exactly and still lists three locations plus PDF/TEI cache flags.
findings.integration_action: Keep both observation receipts and their separate timestamps. Count this as one research metadata read, no new lineage, manuscript acquisition or corpus admission.

findings.title: A Work record does not bind a cached edition
findings.finding: OpenAlex selects the published DOI and ranks OA locations; Work updated_date includes metadata changes such as citation counts. Its fulltext documentation explicitly disallows archive-object matching via locations[].pdf_url. PDF and TEI use distinct UUIDs.
findings.integration_action: Keep cached PDF, TEI, JAIR copy and exact arXiv editions distinct. Require actual object/version/rights binding before content admission; Work-level cc-by metadata is insufficient for exact-edition attribution.

findings.title: Cache availability and access remain separate
findings.finding: Current docs require an API key for per-file content; complete archive sync is a paid service. OpenAlex adds no content rights. Its daily content manifest maps Work IDs to separate object UUIDs, but no manifest row or cached body was inspected.
findings.integration_action: Keep cached objects held. No credentials, content endpoint, paid access or sync was attempted. TEI remains a derived representation and is not proof of complete original text.

findings.title: Metadata grant and lifecycle are distinct from original retention
findings.finding: OpenAlex metadata is CC0. The public metadata snapshot overwrites previous state; the works deletion ledger is replaced rather than append-only. The same Sync page both permits rare restoration and describes deletion as final.
findings.integration_action: Keep source statements and uncertainty together. Track metadata merges/removals without treating them as manuscript withdrawal, copyright revocation or a destruction instruction. Do not propagate mirror-delete instructions to the original archive.

findings.title: Published aggregate counts are unsuitable denominators
findings.finding: Snapshot documentation gives September examples of about 327M default and 476M all works; the October quick reference gives about 324M core plus 193M expansion. Neither is a measured relevant-work population or inspected manifest.
findings.integration_action: Preserve dated examples without reconciling them by arithmetic. Freeze selection-specific IDs, corpus, filters and observation interval before completeness claims.

findings.title: Cursor documentation gap narrowed
findings.finding: Official paging documentation is now inspected: per_page supports 1-100; 200 is deprecated legacy behavior. Basic page×per_page cannot exceed 10,000. Cursor traversal starts with * and follows next_cursor until null with empty results; whole-corpus cursor harvesting is discouraged.
findings.integration_action: Replace “cursor documentation uninspected” with “documentation verified, bounded paginator and completeness behavior unexecuted.” No live paging sequence was run.

findings.title: MIT data-specific grant and publisher links
findings.finding: The official risks page expressly grants CC BY 4.0 for MIT AI Risk Initiative data, and still advertises the same Google Sheets copy and OneDrive full-database links. The page describes source metadata, quotation/page evidence and taxonomy mappings.
findings.integration_action: Attach the grant to initiative/database data. Do not extend it to complete cited papers. Keep publisher-advertised location separate from successfully retrieved workbook.

findings.title: MIT complete native export remains unverified
findings.finding: Neither linked workbook was retried. Uploaded MIT-E03/E04 report tool-side authentication redirects; they establish neither origin HTTP 500 nor universal anonymous-access failure. Current landing-page access succeeds, but native bytes, media type, sheet coverage, revision and mirror equivalence remain unknown.
findings.integration_action: Retain the native-export hold. Preserve historical access observations with their original dates and null origin HTTP status; do not convert a tool error into a server-status claim.

findings.title: MIT release announcement does not pin the live workbook
findings.finding: Version 4 is announced on 2025-12-04. The current risks page advertises 1700+/74 while its FAQ and the release page retain 1600+/65 context. These are inconsistent population labels, not verified export counts.
findings.integration_action: Record the release announcement separately from native workbook identity. Do not assign version 4 or a complete row denominator to a mutable linked workbook without binding evidence.

findings.title: ESPAI v3 retained-copy reconciliation is now satisfied
findings.finding: The parent’s separate 16:04:12 readback report verifies the existing v3 original at 5,902,763 bytes with historical SHA-256 8a440d9f5c24e3627b2887c4b654f8b98253706a92e8e4ece266f8c2fe9903a7. It reports unchanged original metadata/revision and no source-dataset request.
findings.integration_action: Narrow the proposed retained-tranche follow-up: v3 re-download/reconciliation is unnecessary for identity. This is retained-copy reuse, not a newly acquired source body or proof of present arXiv PDF-byte equality.

findings.title: Companion schema remains research-only
findings.finding: The separate offline review passes the supplied ledger and schema checks but demonstrates twelve semantic enforcement gaps. All eight submitted acquisition acceptance cases remain unexecuted.
findings.integration_action: Admit the schema/specification/cases only as proposed research artifacts. Runtime admission must wait for invariant hardening and executed positive/negative tests; do not present standards compliance as production readiness.
